map.输入两个日期，计算它们之间相差的天数、周数、月数与年数，可用于项目周期、年龄跨度: Enter two dates and compute the days, weeks, months and years between them, for project periods, age spans or contract terms — results are shown in several units at once for easy comparison.
map.天数 = 两日期差 + 1（含起始日）；工作日 = 天数 − 落在周六/周日的天: Days = difference between the two dates + 1 (including the start); working days = days − days falling on Saturday/Sunday
map.先交换保证起始 ≤ 结束；未勾选「包含开始日」时起始日 +1 天。天数为日历差加: First swap so the start is ≤ the end; when "include start date" is unchecked the start moves +1 day. Days are the calendar difference plus 1; with "include weekends" checked they are counted as calendar days, otherwise days falling on Saturday or Sunday are subtracted to give working days. Weeks and months/years convert at 7 days per week and 12 months per year.
map.与 date-diff 同，算间隔。: Same as date-diff — it computes an interval.
map.算两次体检、两次续费之间的间隔，判断是否超过周期要求。: Compute the interval between two check-ups or two renewals and judge whether it exceeds the required period.
map.自动处理闰年与跨年。: Handles leap years and year crossings automatically.
map.含开始日和不含差几天？: How many days differ with and without the start day?
map.勾选「包含开始日」结果 +1 天：同一天起止含开始日记为 1 天，不含则记为 0: Checking "include start date" adds 1 day: a same-day start and end counts as 1 day with the start included, and 0 days without it.
